stories.title: Implement Disciplinary Presence Indicator Logic
stories.description: Implement logic to derive a disciplinary presence indicator based solely on availability of state medical board lookup links and known board coverage, without scraping or interpreting disciplinary records.

stories.title: Handle Missing or Unsupported State Board Coverage
stories.description: Add handling for providers in states without predefined medical board link templates, returning a null or unsupported indicator while maintaining consistent schema output.

stories.title: Integrate Disciplinary Signal into Provider Detail Response Model
stories.description: Extend provider detail response structure to include disciplinary signal fields (presence indicator and validated board link) ensuring compatibility with existing Evaluate Care facade outputs.

stories.title: Unit Tests for State Coverage and Presence Indicator Logic
stories.description: Create unit tests validating disciplinary signal behavior across supported states (DE, MS, VA), unsupported states, and edge cases such as missing provider state data.
